title: c51 explores a new class: a Toner-Tu polar active fluid (flocking continuum) whose agents eat a regrowing food and grow on it
summary: Exploration debt: a Toner-Tu density-polarization field theory (self-advection, ordering above a critical density, pressure) with logistic growth on a consumed, regrowing food. Question: do finite travelling flocks form from noise, eat into fresh food and split, like the reacting thermals but without a fluid or gravity? Sighting first.
